episode.descriptionEn: To promote their activities at the Nadeshiko Festival, Kaho and Sayaka are entrusted by their seniors with an article for the newspaper club, and they run around trying to live up to those expectations, but...

花帆さんも村野さんも、そんな気まずそうな顔をしなくても良いわ。
記事のために去年のことを調べようとしていたんでしょう？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue

Kaho-san, Murano-san, you do not need to make such awkward faces.

카호도 무라노도, 그렇게 어색한 표정 짓지 않아도 돼.
기사 때문에 작년 일을 조사하려고 했던 거지?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho

悪いことなんて何もしていないのだから、そう身構えないで。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue

Thank you... very much.
Um, were the two of you looking for us?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka

en_hasuko.text:

That was not... why we came.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue

turns.textJp: ……遅かったみたいね。

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: …But still, it seems we were too late.

大倉庫に残ってるかも……
って気付くのが遅かったってこと？

en_hasuko.speaker: Tsuzuri
en_hasuko.text:
You mean we were too late to realize
it might still be left in the large storage room...?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 츠즈리
ko_hasuko.text:
대창고에 남아있을지도……
라고 깨닫는 게 늦었다는 거야?

en_idolst.speaker: Tsuzuri
en_idolst.text: Or maybe… did you realize too late that there might've been something still here?

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I noticed that people may end up coming here. I did intend on hiding some of these things before then, though.

……확실히, 사퇴했어. 전국 대회.

この子たちは悪くないもの。
部活のために、頑張ってくれただけで。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
These girls did nothing wrong.
They only worked hard for the club.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
이 아이들은 잘못 없어.
동아리를 위해서, 열심히 해줬을 뿐.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: These two did nothing wrong. They were only here to work on something for the club.

turns.textJp:
隠せなかったのは私たちの責任。
だから、変にしこりを残すより、きちんと話した方が良いでしょう。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
It is our responsibility that we failed to hide it.
So rather than leaving behind a strange bad feeling, it is better to explain properly.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
숨기지 못한 건 우리 책임이야.
그러니, 괜히 앙금을 남기기보다, 제대로 이야기하는 편이 좋겠지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Hiding this was our responsibility, so it's only right for us to tell them exactly what happened rather than leave this uncomfortable atmosphere to simmer. Wouldn't you agree?

私と綴理を含めて、一年生が三人。
それから、二年生が一人だけ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Around this time last year, there were a few more members.
Including Tsuzuri and me, there were three first-years.
And then, just one second-year.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
작년 이맘때는, 부원이 좀 더 있었어.
나와 츠즈리를 포함해서, 1학년이 세 명.
그리고, 2학년이 한 명뿐.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Around this time last year, there were more members in the club. Aside from me and Tsuzuri, there was one other first-year student, as well as a second-year student.

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Could that be the student council president's...

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Could it be… the student council president?

turns.textJp:
……ええ。
その先輩は……引退したのよ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue

...Yes.
That senior... retired.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue

それで残された三人で頑張ろうとした矢先に、
もう一人が怪我をしてしまって。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Then, just when the three of us who remained were trying to keep going,
one more person was injured.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에

그래서 남겨진 세 명이서 열심히 하려던 참에,
다른 한 명이 다치고 말았고.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: And not long after we three remaining members decided to try our best to continue, the other member suffered an injury.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue

turns.textJp:
でもね。  足並みが合わなかったのよ。
綴理と私じゃあね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
But, you see. We could not match our steps.
Tsuzuri and I.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만 말이야. 발이 맞지 않았어.
츠즈리와 나는 말이지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: But we couldn't stay in sync with each other.

background.comment: 大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画
大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画

turns.textJp: だから全国大会は辞退したの。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: That is why we declined the national tournament.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Thus, we decided to withdraw from the national tournament.

background.comment: 大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画
大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画

turns.textJp:
地区大会は突破できたし、
突破したからには続けるべきだとも思ったけれど……

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
We had made it through the regional tournament,
and I did think that since we had made it through, we should continue, but...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
지구 대회는 돌파했고,
돌파한 이상 계속해야 한다고도 생각했지만……

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: We'd won the regional tournament, but even though we would be able to continue onward…

background.comment: 大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画

梢.name: 梢
梢.motionDescription: 片手を顔の近くで握りしめる（右）

background.comment: 大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画

turns.textJp:
これ以上続けてもお互い不幸になるだけだったから。
私は……綴理の隣には立てなかった。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Continuing any farther would only make both of us unhappy.
I... could not stand beside Tsuzuri.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
이 이상 계속해도 서로 불행해질 뿐이었으니까.
나는…… 츠즈리의 옆에 설 수 없었어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: We knew that we wouldn't be happy if we went on in the state we were in. I… couldn't stand next to her.

background.comment: 大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画
大倉庫の中の聖堂のような区画

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Ah...

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Ah…

turns.textJp:
だから、もう一緒にやらないって決めた。
でも、それで問題は無いの。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
So we decided that we would not perform together anymore.
But there is no problem with that.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
그래서, 이제 같이 하지 않기로 정했어.
하지만, 그걸로 문제는 없어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: We decided that we wouldn't perform together anymore. But to be clear, that isn't a problem.

さやか.name: さやか

さやか.name: さやか
さやか.motionDescription: さやか汎用3_腰の前に手をおく（右）

turns.textJp:
綴理にはもう村野さんが居て、
私には花帆さんが居るから。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Tsuzuri has you now, Murano-san,
and I have Kaho-san.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
츠즈리에게는 이제 무라노가 있고,
나에게는 카호가 있으니까.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Now, Tsuzuri has Murano-san, and I have Kaho-san, after all.

さやか.name: さやか

さやか.motionDescription: さやか汎用3_腰の前に手をおく（右）

turns.textJp:
変に勘繰らせたならごめんなさい。
でも、心配なんて一つもないから。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
I am sorry if we made you suspect strange things.
But there is not a single thing to worry about.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
괜히 억측하게 했다면 미안해.
하지만, 걱정할 건 하나도 없으니까.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I apologize for causing all these misconceptions. But, I don't think there's any need to worry.

turns.textJp: だからーーこの話はここまでよ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: So... this conversation ends here.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: So… let's shelve this discussion here.

en_hasuko.text: Kozue-senpai...

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Kozue-senpai…

turns.textJp:
そんな顔しないで。  私たちは、大丈夫だから。
ねえ、綴理。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Do not make that face. We are all right.
Right, Tsuzuri?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
그런 표정 짓지 마. 우리는, 괜찮으니까.
그렇지, 츠즈리.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Please don't look at me that way. The two of us are fine with this. Right, Tsuzuri?

turns.textJp: ……うん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Tsuzuri
en_hasuko.text: ...Yeah.

en_idolst.speaker: Tsuzuri
en_idolst.text: …Yeah.

turns.textJp:
じゃあ、先に戻っていて。
私はここを片づけていくから。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Then please go back ahead of us.
I will clean up here before I leave.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
그럼, 먼저 돌아가 있어.
나는 여기 정리하고 갈 테니까.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Now then, why don't you go on ahead? I have some reorganizing to do here.

I couldn't say anything.

아무 말도 못 했어.
코즈에 선배, 분명 무리하고 있었어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho

さやか.motionDescription: 着座手を下の方で広げる（両手）

turns.textJp:
……そうですね。
おふたりとも、です。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
...Yes.
Both of them were.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: …You're right. They both were…

門前 歩道（パン演出用の星空込）夜

turns.textJp:
どうにかしたいなんて言って……
ただセンパイたちに嫌な思いさせただけだ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I said I wanted to do something...
But all I did was make our senpai feel awful.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호

어떻게든 하고 싶다고 해놓고……
그냥 선배들한테 싫은 기억만 떠올리게 했을 뿐이야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I said I would do anything to help… but when the time came, I just made them feel bad.

turns.textJp: ぐすっ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Sniff.

우리들이 어떻게든 할 수 있을지도 모른다고 해놓고…….

っ。

en_hasuko.text:
...
